text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: A nonzero reduced germ character with zero KK-class
Actual source fibres; point-norm homotopy; original normal degree and coefficient retained.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: A. Move the receiving point through actual negative unit fibres — ECH.1–ECH.5
Parameters: t = 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, and the endpoint limit 1. Every negative source fibre has one unit.
The distinct zero-source germs remain F2. This representation family does not replace their counting norm.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: B. A fixed test and the map norms — ECH.8
Continuity is for each fixed source element.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: C. The whole interval cycle — ECH.6–ECH.7

g.text: The endpoint has zero action and is degenerate.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: D. Keep the original normal requirement — ECH.9–ECH.10
Finite point actions give zero restriction; a different normal transfer is not presumed to factor through them.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #354d5c

g.text: Vanishing of this scalar class does not exclude a different normally geometric class on the full actual graph.
